final: WITH account_region AS (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 0 - t.amount END) AS net_amount, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3), total AS (SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS total_amount FROM account_region) SELECT ar.account_id, ar.region, ar.net_amount, ar.record_count, CAST(ar.net_amount AS REAL) / total.total_amount AS share FROM account_region AS ar JOIN total ON total.total_amount IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10
